name: CMS Multi-Role Login
desc: Central unified authentication for Super Admin, Accounts, Warehouse, Operations, and Developers. Validates email/password + OTP, checks panel permissions, issues RS256 JWT access (15m) & refresh (2d) tokens via httpOnly cookies, and redirects users to their assigned department portal.

name: BDE Login
desc: Dedicated authentication service for Business Development Executives. Validates credentials, attaches assigned geographic territory and franchisee pipeline scope to the user session.

name: Franchise Login & Registration
desc: Mobile number OTP verification and 4-digit PIN setup for regional Franchise Partners. Handles session token management, account status verification, and rate limiting against brute-force attacks.

name: EPC Contractor Login/Signup
desc: Self-service onboarding and authentication for EPC solar contractors. Grants access to preconfigured combo kits, custom kit builders, and bulk purchasing with contractor pricing.

name: Multi-Role CMS Panel & Scope Authorization
desc: Enterprise role-based access control granting compartmentalized permissions across Super Admin, Accounts, Warehouse, Operations, Developer, and BDE portals with dynamic panel scope resolution.

name: Admin Creates BDE
desc: Super Admin interface to onboard new BDE field agents, upload identity KYC documents (Aadhaar, PAN), assign territorial states/districts, and configure monthly franchisee onboarding targets.

name: BDE Dashboard
desc: Operational command dashboard for field agents displaying real-time lead counts, pipeline conversion velocity, store setup milestone progress, and monthly target fulfillment metrics.

name: BDE Lead Management
desc: Comprehensive lead tracking module allowing BDEs to register prospective franchise leads, schedule customer visits, record meeting minutes, log activity trails, and advance leads through onboarding stages.

name: BDE Store Setup (16-Step)
desc: 16-step physical store setup verification engine (branding, signage, display kits, IT infrastructure). BDE uploads on-site photo proofs, submits delay exception requests, and requests final admin certification.

name: BDE Franchise Pipeline
desc: Pipeline tracking visualization monitoring converted leads through KYC verification, offline fee receipt upload, physical store setup, and final operational activation.

name: Admin BDE Dashboard
desc: Admin oversight dashboard monitoring field agent KPIs, tracking lead-to-onboarding conversion rates, reviewing KYC submissions, and dynamically reallocating territory quotas.

name: BDE Territory Assignment
desc: Administrative tool to map geographic boundaries (states, districts, clusters) to specific BDE agents with strict territory exclusivity enforcement.

name: BDE Activity History
desc: Complete audit trail logging BDE field interactions, status changes, photo proof uploads, and franchisee verification submissions with timestamps.

name: Franchise Landing Page

name: KYC Workspace (GST, PAN, Aadhaar)

name: Offline Fee Payment & Receipt Upload

name: Franchise Dashboard
desc: Operational homepage for active franchise partners displaying real-time Franchise Earning totals, commission summaries, EPC order pipeline, assigned territory leads, and recent dispatch milestones.

name: Authorized Product Catalog
desc: Catalog allowing franchise partners to browse admin-approved solar kits, configure regional profit margins, and selectively publish systems to local EPC contractors.

name: Franchise Earning & Commission
desc: Digital earnings ledger tracking real-time commission accruals and net Franchise Earning from EPC orders. Enables franchise partners to monitor balances and submit bank withdrawal requests for manual payout processing.

name: EPC Buyer Management
desc: CRM module enabling franchise partners to register local EPC contractors, manage customer relationships, and track regional contractor purchase volume.

name: Franchise PO Orders
desc: Purchase order engine allowing franchise partners to procure bulk stock from central warehouses based on tier-specific discount rules and credit limits.

name: Store Setup Tracking
desc: Franchisee-facing progress tracker displaying status of the 16 physical store setup milestones and assigned BDE agent inspection schedules.

name: Procurement & Inventory
desc: Franchise inventory management portal to order bulk solar equipment, log incoming warehouse deliveries, and maintain local stock levels.

name: Storefront Listings (Publish to EPC)
desc: Pricing and listing manager enabling franchise partners to adjust selling prices, apply percentage/fixed margins, and publish products to EPC storefronts.

name: Territory Eligibility Checker
desc: Interactive district search allowing prospective applicants to check territory exclusivity availability before submitting franchise applications.

name: PlansPortal (Franchise Plans)
desc: Showcase portal displaying franchise package tiers, upfront fee schedules, commission rates, and territory rights (UI present; route currently commented in App.jsx). Dedicated subscription verification route and public franchise plan catalog on landing page.

name: Loose Order
desc: Component procurement module for purchasing standalone non-bundled solar parts (panels, inverters, cables) outside standard combo kits (currently a placeholder stub). Complete 1,205-line enterprise module with kit selection, loose presets, EPC allocation, offline payment slip upload, and real-time ICICI payment events.

name: Product Template Management
desc: Master catalog engine to create standardized product templates with configurable technical attribute groups, specifications, and automated SKU generation.

name: Solar Kits Management
desc: Admin module to bundle individual solar components into complete solar kits (On-Grid, Off-Grid, Hybrid), configuring baseline pricing and warehouse activations.

name: Combo Kits & Variants

name: Industry Type & Project Hierarchy
desc: Taxonomy hierarchy manager structuring solar systems across Industry > Category > SubCategory > SystemType > Capacity tiers.

name: Industry Content CMS
desc: Dynamic marketing CMS to upload promotional banners, video testimonials, YouTube walkthroughs, and technical posters categorized by industry segment.

name: Website Content CMS
desc: Content management engine for public websites controlling hero banners, FAQs, terms of service, partner testimonials, and promotional announcements.

name: Geolocation Management
desc: Geographic master database managing countries, states, districts, pin codes, and territory cluster boundaries across India.

name: User & Role Management
desc: RBAC security management engine defining internal departments, panel permissions, module access rights, and staff account creation.

name: Franchise Management & Receipt Approval
desc: Central verification interface to review franchise KYC submissions, inspect uploaded payment receipt slips, verify bank UTRs, track Franchise Earning, and activate operational accounts.

name: Store Setup Administration
desc: Admin governance tool to inspect 16-step BDE store setup photo proofs, approve delay exception requests, and certify new franchise store openings.

name: Franchise PO Settings
desc: Configuration manager establishing minimum order quantities (MOQ), payment terms, and credit thresholds for franchise purchase orders.

name: Commission & MOQ Rules
desc: Rules engine configuring percentage and fixed commission formulas for franchise partners based on sales volumes and kit categories.

name: Warehouse Management (Admin)

name: Supplier Management
desc: Supplier registry managing solar equipment manufacturers, brand partnerships, product supply lines, and contract pricing.

name: EPC Management
desc: Contractor registry monitoring registered EPC installers, account statuses, and territorial activity. Administrative governance for verified EPC solar contractors, authorized kit assignments, and regional distribution tracking.

name: Approve New EPC
desc: Verification workflow to review and approve newly registered EPC contractor accounts. Verification workflow for new EPC contractor applications, reviewing GSTIN, trade licenses, and assigning contractor price tiers.

name: Price Master (SKU Pricing)
desc: Centralized pricing matrix controlling base SKU costs, benchmark rates, and dynamic price approval workflows.

name: Units Management
desc: Measurement configuration managing packaging units, weights, electrical metrics (kW, Wp, Ah, V), and conversion factors.

name: Preconfigured Combo Kits
desc: EPC store catalog displaying turnkey solar kits with real-time district warehouse inventory polling every 30 seconds.

name: Custom Combo Kit Builder
desc: Interactive kit builder enabling EPC contractors to customize panel brands, inverter capacities, and mounting structures with dynamic BOM pricing.

name: Bulk Buy
desc: Volume procurement portal offering tiered bulk discounts for commercial and industrial solar installations.

name: Cart & Order Confirmation (Offline Receipt / Request)
desc: Cart and checkout engine featuring 30-minute stock reservation, GST validation, and offline bank transfer receipt attachment.

name: EPC Catalogue (Tenant-Isolated)
desc: Tenant-isolated catalog ensuring EPC contractors view regional franchise pricing while manufacturer baseline costs remain completely hidden.

name: Store Locator
desc: Geographic locator interface displaying nearby company warehouses and franchise stores for self-pickup of solar equipment.

name: Request Order

name: Dynamic Combo Kit BOM Customizer
desc: Interactive Bill of Materials (BOM) customizer allowing EPC contractors to dynamically configure solar panels, inverters, mounting structures, and electrical balance components with live technical validation.

name: Order Status Tracking
desc: Real-time order tracking portal showing order verification, warehouse picking, dispatch transporter details, and delivery milestones.

name: Landing Page
desc: Consumer retail landing page showcasing solar benefits and residential rooftop packages (currently using static mock content). Dynamic consumer landing page integrated with centralized Website CMS, showcasing solar benefits and residential rooftop packages.

name: Industries Showcase Page
desc: Industry showcase page presenting tailored solar solutions for agriculture, commercial, industrial, and residential sectors. Dynamic Industry Solutions CMS showcase presenting tailored solar packages for agriculture, commercial, industrial, and residential sectors.

name: Warehouse Kit Activation Engine (ADM_WH_KIT_ACT)
desc: Stage 1 Warehouse Kit Activation enforcing 3 mandatory prerequisite validation gates (Cluster SKU Benchmark Pricing, Company Profit Margin, GST Rate Configuration) before allowing any kit to become active in a warehouse.

name: Bulk Kit Auto-Deactivation Cascade Engine
desc: Business rule automation engine that cascades deactivations: disabling a Combo Kit in a warehouse automatically disables linked Bulk Kit configurations (autoDeactivateBulkKit) preventing unvalidated wholesale purchases.

name: District Order Management Scoping (ADM_ORD_MGMT)
desc: Stage 2 District Fulfillment Configuration supporting Country -> State -> Cluster -> District geographic hierarchy selection with automated Master Warehouse fallback when a district lacks local warehouse facilities.

name: Sequential Fulfillment Pipeline Chains
desc: Strict toggle dependency chain enforcement: Combo/Customize Kits (Sub-Warehouse -> Nearest Supplier -> In-Cluster Supplier) and Bulk Kits (Sub-Warehouse -> Master Warehouse -> Nearest Supplier -> In-Cluster Supplier) with automated reverse cascade.

name: Multi-Order Supplier PO Combination Engine
desc: Accounts procurement consolidation engine allowing staff to select multiple pending EPC and Franchise customer orders and combine them into a single consolidated Supplier Purchase Order with auto-calculated BOM cost ratios (Panels ~60%, Inverters ~25%, Others ~15%).

name: Supplier PO Payment & Tax Invoice Registration
desc: Comprehensive supplier procurement payment workflow capturing supplier selection, destination warehouse, NEFT/RTGS/UPI reference, payment receipt upload, Proforma Invoice details, and transitional 'paid / awaiting delivery' status tracking.

name: Material Inward & GRN Generation (Inventory Inward)
desc: Warehouse inward verification workflow recording supplier Tax Invoice No, GSTIN, and PDF upload, auto-generating Goods Receipt Notes (GRN) with QC discrepancy fields (Accepted Qty, Damaged Qty, Shortage notes) and real-time inventory increment.

name: Customer Order Inward Fulfillment Bridge
desc: Supply chain bridge connecting received supplier GRN stock batches to specific pending customer sales orders, validating component availability before releasing orders to the outbound delivery management queue.

name: Real-Time FIFO Stock Allocation & Deduction Engine

name: Offline Payment & Receipt Upload System
desc: Central financial transaction engine handling offline bank transfer slip uploads, UTR number capture, Cloudinary document storage, and accounts verification.

desc: Financial management panel for Accounts team to review franchisee earning withdrawal requests, process manual bank payouts via NEFT/RTGS, and log UTR numbers.

name: Accounts Panel (Solar Shop Finance)

name: Purchase Orders (Accounts)
desc: Complete purchase order lifecycle tracking supplier invoices, bank payment slips, tax deductions, and milestone payments.

name: Supplier Registry (Accounts)
desc: Supplier financial registry maintaining vendor GSTIN, bank account details, MSME registration, and payment terms.

name: Material Inward (Stock Inward)

name: Material Outward & Delivery

name: Vehicle & Driver Management
desc: Fleet logistics registry managing company transport vehicles, driver assignments, insurance renewals, and trip logs.

name: Inventory Transfer, Stock Adj, Replacement
desc: Warehouse stock management tool facilitating inter-warehouse material transfers, damaged stock write-offs, and customer warranty replacements. Inter-warehouse stock transfer tracking, physical inventory reconciliation, damaged stock write-offs, and warranty replacements.

name: Repair Tickets
desc: Maintenance service desk logging RMA tickets for defective solar inverters, panels, or meters requiring factory repair (backend route pending). Service desk and RMA repair tracking for defective solar inverters, solar panels, and meters requiring factory maintenance.

name: Operations Panel (Order Dispatch, Logistics)
desc: Operations control center coordinating logistics milestones, courier tracking, and site delivery confirmations (backend API routes under-built). Operations control center coordinating logistics milestones, 8-stage tracking, transporter assignment, and site delivery confirmations.

name: BDE Notifications
desc: Automated notification feed alerting field agents about lead status changes, store inspection milestones, and target achievements.

name: Delivery & Logistics Milestone Alerts
desc: Multi-channel delivery notification engine dispatching automated WhatsApp, SMS, and Email alerts to EPC contractors and Franchisees across key order lifecycle stages (PO Inward, Out for Delivery, Delivered).

name: Email (Nodemailer)
desc: Automated backend email service dispatching KYC approval notices, invoice PDFs, and password reset links via SMTP.

name: SMS/WhatsApp (Twilio)
desc: Instant messaging gateway sending one-time login passwords (OTP), delivery dispatch alerts, and critical account updates.

name: BDE Performance & Conversion Funnel
desc: Analytics dashboard evaluating field agent productivity, lead-to-onboarding conversion rates, and regional revenue contribution.

name: Warehouse Turnaround & Logistics Analytics
desc: Executive logistics telemetry evaluating warehouse stock turnover rates, supplier delivery lead times, GRN discrepancy ratios, vehicle cargo load utilization, and average dispatch turnaround time (TAT).

name: Franchise Analytics (Admin)
desc: Business analytics evaluating franchise partner sales volume, average order values, and commission distribution.

name: NoSQL Injection Prevention
desc: Global security middleware (`mongo.sanitize`) sanitizing all incoming payloads by stripping MongoDB operator keys ($ and .).

name: Rate Limiting (Auth, GST, OTP)
desc: API protection middleware throttling authentication attempts, OTP generation, and GST API calls to prevent brute-force attacks.

name: JWT with httpOnly Cookies
desc: Secure authentication token architecture utilizing RS256 encryption with 15-minute access tokens and 2-day refresh cookies.

name: CORS Vulnerability (Over-permissive)
desc: CORS origin callback in server bootstrap currently allows all origins unconditionally (requires immediate restriction).

name: Receipt Slip File Upload Validation
desc: Multipart form validation middleware inspecting uploaded payment slips for valid image/PDF MIME types and file size bounds.

name: KYC & Payment Document Private Delivery
desc: Document storage pipeline saving sensitive verification documents and payment slips to Cloudinary (requires enforcement of private signed URLs).

name: Docker Multi-Stage Build
desc: Production containerization script creating optimized, minimal Node.js and static web server runtime containers.

name: Nginx Reverse Proxy
desc: Reverse proxy routing HTTP/HTTPS traffic to internal port services with SSL termination and gzip compression.

name: Render.com Live Deployment

name: ICICI Bank E-Collection Engine

name: 8-Stage Order & Dispatch Tracking Pipeline
desc: Complete physical supply chain management featuring Tab 7 (FIFO Delivery Queue with cargo weight/kW metrics and combine delivery suggestions) and Tab 8 (Trip Tracking & Proof of Delivery confirmation across 8 distinct transit milestones).

name: Smart Vehicle Fleet Assignment & Recommendation
desc: Automated logistics fleet recommendation engine evaluating vehicle payload (kg), max kit limits, kW load limits, and serviceable geographic districts with mandatory Admin override auditing and reason logging.

name: Dynamic Industry Solutions CMS Engine
desc: Centralized dynamic content management system allowing administrators to configure tailored solar solutions, technical brochures, application cases, and media assets for Agriculture, Commercial, Industrial, and Residential sectors.
